mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the inflation signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the labor market signal, or UNRATE < 5% does not correlate with subsequent wage inflation.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate activity (HOUST) signals increased consumer confidence and demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances despite the positive housing signal, or HOUST increases do not correlate with increased consumer confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative industrial production signal, or INDPRO YoY < 0% does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) and a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a potential monetary policy mismatch, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the monetary policy signal, or the combination of high CPIAUCSL and low FEDFUNDS does not correlate with subsequent policy adjustments.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a low unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the strong labor market signal, or the combination of PAYEMS growth and low UNRATE does not correlate with subsequent economic strength.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real final sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the strong demand signal, or RSAFS YoY > 5% does not correlate with subsequent economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP (GDPC1) combined with a rise in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a potential supply chain disruption, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the supply chain disruption signal, or the combination of declining GDP and rising INDPRO does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.
